title: Norway Plans AI Glass Ban in Public Zones to Curb Filming

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The Norwegian administration intends to block the use of vision-based AI wearables in several high-traffic environments, including beaches, schools and kindergartens. A government minister cited concerns over the unauthorized filming of the public as the primary driver for the move, targeting the ability of these devices to record video discreetly. This effort reflects a broader international trend as multiple nations are currently reviewing their laws to determine if similar prohibitions on smart glasses are necessary.

The restrictions could limit critical accessibility for blind and hard-of-hearing users who use the technology to describe surroundings, read signs and transcribe speech to text. While acknowledging these utility benefits, the Norwegian government has cautioned that a perceived lack of safety in society might cause residents to withdraw from public life. The move creates potential headwinds for manufacturers like Meta as governments prioritize privacy over the deployment of wearable AI.
